current.text: Booker is projected to start for Phoenix next to Jalen Green, Dillon Brooks, Miles Bridges and Oso Ighodaro.
The Suns do not want Booker to be the primary point guard. They want to lower his ballhandling load and make spacing easier for him.
Phoenix may play him off the ball more this season, which could keep his assists down.
Jalen Green's usage could squeeze him a little. Miles Bridges and Dillon Brooks also take touches in a crowded Phoenix offense.
He is expected to be the best fantasy player on the Suns by a wide margin.
The experts disagree on a bounce back. One says he can bounce back. Others doubt it and expect a season close to last year's finish around 40th in category leagues.
If he gets back to about 2.4 threes a game at 35%, he could be roughly a 28th to 30th ranked player.
He is a fade at his market price. Do not take him in round two or early round three in category leagues. Take him around picks 35 to 38. Going around pick 27 in mocks is a bit early.
In auctions, Josh values him in the low 20s USD. In a mock he went for 22 USD, which Josh called a good price.
Phoenix has the best fantasy schedule in the league: 4, 4 and 4 games in the playoff weeks, and the fewest back-to-backs.
Yahoo lists him as questionable for rest.

durable.text: Booker is an elite free throw shooter on high volume, with 7 to 8 attempts a game. This lifts a team's FT% clearly.
FT% swings a lot from year to year. Even an 89% shooter could randomly drop to 81% in a season.
His scoring is a real outlier. He projects for about 27 points a game, far above the top 250 pool.
He commits many turnovers, about 3 a game, which clearly hurts the TO category.
He is an average NBA defender: not a net negative, but not good.

note: Booker brings two real strengths, FT% (z +2.7) and points (26.7 a game), plus good assists. He also costs you about 3 turnovers a game, so he fits a punt TO build best. Our league paid 45 USD for him last season and Yahoo values him at 31 USD. The experts put him in the low 20s (22 USD in a mock) and ESPN values him at 17 USD, so do not chase him above about 25 to 30 USD. Early in the season, check whether he plays off the ball next to Jalen Green. His assists and three-point volume (2.4 threes a game at 35% is the bounce-back mark) decide whether he returns to top 30. Phoenix's 4-4-4 playoff schedule is a bonus.
